messages:
Maya Chen: Quick sync — product wants to dark-launch the EU model upgrade next week. High-level ask: validate regen quality vs v2, measure cost delta, and make sure p95 latency stays under 200ms. Proposed flow: 1) 1% tenant micro-canary (30m) -> 5% canary (2h) -> 20% staggered over 24h -> full. Gate on latency p95, error rate, and quality evals. Thoughts? @aj @sam :eyes:
Aj Patel: +1 on staged percentages. Two notes: we need per-tenant flag overrides and an immediate kill-switch. Flag names suggestion: `rollout:model-v3:eu:micro` and `rollout:model-v3:eu:canary`. Also add a global `rollout:model-v3:eu:panic` that flips everything back.
Samir Gupta: Telemetry details — we'll emit `canary.metrics.latency_p95`, `canary.metrics.error_rate`, `canary.metrics.eval_pass_rate`, and `canary.metrics.token_cost_per_min`. Gating logic: evaluate 5-min rolling windows. If any gate trips (latency p95 >200ms OR error_rate >0.3% OR eval_pass_rate <95%) twice within a 15m window -> auto rollback. Also include a soft alarm to notify infra before auto-action.
Tess Rivera: Ops playbook notes: rollback should have two levels: soft (traffic revert to v2 for canary slices) and hard (global rollback + capacity switch). Add an intermediate fallback to route affected traffic to Dedicated pool for high-value tenants. We need runbook steps and contact list.
deploy-bot: scheduled job created: `canary-job/model-v3-eu` -> starts 2024-06-02T09:00:00Z, micro-canary first. See https://ci.redwood.example/jobs/12345
Maya Chen: Runbook snippet for the flagging side (for engineering):
```
# Example flag usage
feature_flags.set("rollout:model-v3:eu:micro", true)   # 1% micro-canary
feature_flags.set("rollout:model-v3:eu:canary", "5%")
feature_flags.set("rollout:model-v3:eu:panic", false)
```
We should also wire a cost-guard: if token_cost_per_min rises >20% vs baseline for two consecutive 10m windows, throttle canary to 0.5% and notify finance.
Aj Patel: Implementation notes — infra will add per-tenant opt-out list and a `tenant_holdback` flag. Also propose a `traffic-evict` policy: if CPU/GPU utilization >85% for more than 5m, divert canary traffic to lower-cost model-quantized variant or to a spare region.
Samir Gupta: For quality gating, we'll run automatic evals on a fixed prompt set and a holdout customer prompt pool. Eval pass criterion = 95% non-regression by metric X (TBD). We'll post the metric dashboards to the rollout channel and tag product.
Maya Chen: Owners & action items: @Aj — flag infra + kill-switch (ETA 48h), @Samir — telemetry dashboards & gating config (ETA 72h), @Tess — ops runbook + rollback contacts (ETA 48h). Product will prep customer comms and a short FAQ.
Tess Rivera: I'll draft the runbook and include the emergency Slack play: `#product-rollouts` + phone tree for >1h outages. Also adding a note to require a preflight checklist: load test at 5% replica, model size/latency smoke, eval pass.
Maya Chen: Decision: proceed with the micro-canary next Tuesday assuming infra & telemetry deliverables done. If anyone sees a blocker, flag here before EOD tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
Aj Patel: Acknowledged. Will post PR with flag schema and rollout automation by EOD. :+1:
Samir Gupta: Working on dashboards now, will post links when ready. :bar_chart:
Tess Rivera: Runbook stub in Confluence in 2 hours, will ping here. :notebook_with_decorative_cover:
Maya Chen: Thanks team — keeping this thread as the single-source discussion for the rollout plan.
